subject: Beacon Labs — LangChain / LlamaIndex integration: solutioning and SOW
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@beaconlabs.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: integration@beaconlabs.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Beacon Labs x Redwood — LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime bridge

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the time in the call today. As discussed, Beacon Labs is evaluating two integration patterns to surface our document QA product through ISV SDKs:

- A language-model forwarding integration (LangChain agent wrappers) for quick GTM and demo flows.
- A deeper runtime shim that lets customers use LlamaIndex indexes backed by Beacon's vector store with token-preserving attributions and tracing hooks for audit.

We're particularly concerned about: security of sample data, traceability for prompt changes, and cost predictability at high throughput (1000s qps in peak). I attached a short integration spec and a sample schema.

Can Redwood outline what a minimal SOW would look like to support both an initial LangChain adapter (2-week POC) and a follow-on LlamaIndex runtime shim (4–6 week effort)? Also: can you confirm whether your hosted API supports per-request tracing headers that we can ingest into our observability pipeline?

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations, Beacon Labs

Attachments: beacon_integration_spec_v1.pdf (spec, 2 pages), beacon_sample_schema.csv (sample payload)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@beaconlabs.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beacon Labs x Redwood — LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime bridge

Samir — thanks, this is clear and very actionable.

Quick answers up front:
- Hosted API supports per-request tracing headers (X-Redwood-Trace-ID) and we can deliver a lightweight webhook that mirrors trace ids to a Beacon endpoint for correlation.
- For an initial LangChain adapter POC (2 weeks): scope is adapter + example notebook + test harness and CI smoke tests.
- For the LlamaIndex runtime shim (4–6 weeks): scope includes index-compat layer, KV-cache management for streamed responses, attribution hooks, and a tracing integration that surfaces token-level regressions to your SREs.

I'll put together a draft SOW and a topline estimate; looping in Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (solutions) to validate commercial/ops constraints. Karthik from runtime should weigh in on the perf assumptions.

Proposed near-term milestones:
1) POC kickoff and sandbox access (week 1)
2) LangChain adapter demo + acceptance tests (end week 2)
3) LlamaIndex shim design review (week 3)
4) Shim dev, perf tuning, and final acceptance (weeks 4–6)

Would Beacon prefer a single SOW covering both phases or two smaller statements of work?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Samir Rao <samir@beaconlabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beacon Labs x Redwood — LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime bridge

Looping in commercial and runtime leads. A few commercial notes:
- If Beacon wants a single SOW, we should include an initial pilot discount and a clear acceptance criteria for the LangChain POC to trigger the start of the shim work.
- We need to confirm data handling (sample vs. production): will Beacon host the vector store in their environment or use Redwood Dedicated? That changes our liability and packaging.

Marissa — can you draft a 2-part SOW (POC + shim) with options for hosted vs dedicated deployment? Karthik, can you confirm the perf baseline assumptions we should include (GPU type, batch size range, kv cache retention)?

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@beaconlabs.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: integration@beaconlabs.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beacon Labs x Redwood — LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime bridge

Thanks team — quick clarifications from our side:
- For security, Beacon prefers to host vectors in our cloud account during pilot; long term we may consider Redwood Dedicated.
- We can provide sanitized sample data for the POC.
- For tracing: happy to receive X-Redwood-Trace-ID and have it mirrored to our SIEM; we have a webhook endpoint at https://hooks.beaconlabs.ai/redwood-traces (auth via mTLS).

I just uploaded a slightly expanded integration spec and a short product requirements doc to your shared Drive folder (links below). Also attaching an updated sample schema.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft SOW.

—Samir

Attachments: beacon_sample_schema_v2.csv
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Abeacon-sandbox
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@beaconlabs.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Beacon Labs x Redwood — LangChain/LlamaIndex runtime bridge

Samir / team — attaching a first-pass two-part SOW and a short acceptance checklist for the LangChain POC. Highlights:
- LangChain POC (2 weeks): fixed price — adapter + demo, includes tests for sampling correctness, simple tracing pass-through, and a joint acceptance demo.
- LlamaIndex runtime shim (4–6 weeks): time & materials estimate with cap; includes index compatibility, KV caching TTL config, token-level attribution hooks, and optional deployment support for Beacon-hosted vectors.
- Deliverables include code in a customer sandbox repo, test harness, and a short handover doc.

Please review the SOW (redwood-draft-sow.md) in the shared Drive and flag any major gaps by Monday 07 Jul. We'll prepare a commercial proposal after we confirm deployment preference (Beacon-hosted vs Redwood Dedicated).

Next steps assigned:
- Beacon: confirm deployment preference and acceptance criteria (Samir / Vera)
- Redwood: finalize SOW and perf baseline (Marissa / Karthik)

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-draft-sow.md
